purpose: Verify permanent data purge approved workflow with dual authorization
preconditions: Archived dataset exceeds retention period; Super Admin requests purge
action_or_input: Super Admin submits purge request; IT Head provides second authorization
expected_result: Purge executed; dataset permanently removed; audit evidence preserved

purpose: Verify permanent data purge rejected workflow when second authorization denied
preconditions: Retention-expired dataset; Super Admin submits purge request
action_or_input: IT Head reviews and formally rejects purge request
expected_result: Purge rejected; dataset retained in archived status; rejection audit logged

purpose: Verify purge request for data still within retention period is rejected at entry
preconditions: Dataset currently within active retention period
action_or_input: Submit purge request for unexpired dataset
expected_result: Purge request rejected; retention constraint error

purpose: Verify purge request lifecycle state progression from requested to decided
preconditions: Purge request submitted by Super Admin
action_or_input: Query purge request status during review lifecycle
expected_result: Request displayed in pending status with audit details

purpose: Verify decision submitted for already decided purge request is rejected
preconditions: Purge request already decided (approved or rejected)
action_or_input: Submit second decision on terminal purge request
expected_result: Operation rejected; request already finalized

purpose: Verify immediate time-bound role assignment activates and reaches expiry state
preconditions: Target user exists; Super Admin authenticated
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; role assignment is active

purpose: Verify role assignment missing required start date is rejected
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; required date missing

purpose: Verify future-dated role assignment activates when effective start date is reached
preconditions: Target user exists; Super Admin authenticated
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; role assignment created

purpose: Verify scheduled assignment does not activate if user account is deactivated before start date
preconditions: Role scheduled for future date; user deactivated prior to start date
action_or_input: Start date reached for deactivated user
expected_result: Role activation blocked; access not granted

purpose: Verify role validity extension traversal updating end date before expiry
preconditions: Active role assignment exists with current end_date
action_or_input: Super Admin updates end_date to new later date
expected_result: End date updated; active validity extended

purpose: Verify extension attempt on already expired role is rejected
action_or_input: Attempt to extend validity of expired role
expected_result: Extension rejected; new assignment required for expired role

purpose: Verify early role revocation state transition from active to revoked
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; role status set to revoked

purpose: Verify revoking an already revoked role assignment is rejected
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; already inactive role cannot be revoked

purpose: Verify role reassignment workflow transitioning prior holder to revoked and new holder to active
action_or_input: Revoke User A assignment and assign role to User B
expected_result: User A role revoked; User B role active

purpose: Verify role assignment rejection path when end_date < start_date
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; inverted dates rejected

purpose: Verify singular role assignment rejection path when role is already actively occupied
preconditions: Singular role actively held by User A
action_or_input: POST /api/super-admin/roles/assign with singular role to User B
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; duplicate singular role occupancy rejected

purpose: Verify role assignment rejection path when user type is ineligible
action_or_input: POST /api/super-admin/roles/assign with faculty role to student
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; ineligible user_type rejected

purpose: Verify deactivation of user account triggers revocation/inactivation of assigned roles
preconditions: User has active account and active role
expected_result: User account deactivated; effective role access terminated

purpose: Verify user account deactivation transition from active to deactivated
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; status updated to deactivated

purpose: Verify user account reactivation transition from deactivated to active
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; status updated to active

purpose: Verify restoration workflow of archived account within reversible retention window
preconditions: User is archived within reversible window
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; user restored from archived to deactivated

purpose: Verify restoration workflow directly restoring archived account to active status
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; user restored directly to active

purpose: Verify transition from archived to permanently non-restorable upon window expiry
expected_result: User finalized as permanently non-restorable

purpose: Verify restoration attempt after window expiry is rejected
action_or_input: Attempt restoration of permanently non-restorable user
expected_result: Restoration rejected; permanent archive status preserved

purpose: Verify direct archival of active user without prior deactivation is rejected
action_or_input: PATCH /api/super-admin/users/<id>/status with status='archived' directly from active
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; direct archival prohibited

purpose: Verify user status transition from active to suspended
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; user status updated to suspended

purpose: Verify user status transition from suspended back to active
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; user status updated to active

purpose: Verify transition of eligible deactivated user to archived state
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; user status updated to archived

purpose: Verify historical data archival workflow moving inactive records to archive
preconditions: Closed academic data eligible for archival; backup succeeds
expected_result: Dataset moved to archive; active storage cleared; backup verified

purpose: Verify historical archival aborts when pre-archival backup fails
expected_result: Archival aborted; active data untouched

purpose: Verify historical data restore workflow upon approved authorization
expected_result: Data restored to active database

purpose: Verify historical data restore rejected without authorization
action_or_input: Execute historical restore workflow without approval
expected_result: Restoration rejected; approval required

purpose: Verify workflow entry point rejects unauthenticated requests
expected_result: HTTP 401 Unauthorized / 403 Forbidden; access denied

purpose: Verify workflow state transition write rejects missing CSRF token
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden; CSRF validation failed

purpose: Verify every workflow transition generates an immutable audit log record
preconditions: Super Admin executes user and role lifecycle workflows
expected_result: Audit entries recorded with actor, action, timestamp, details
